selector.rationale: The presence of well-developed cornoid lamellae, individual cell dyskeratosis, and vacuolar degeneration of the basal cell layer in the histopathology results, along with the clinical presentation of intensely pruritic papules, supports Grover's disease as the most likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Darier's disease
rejected.why: While Darier's disease shares some histopathological features with Grover's disease, the lack of characteristic suprabasal acantholytic dyskeratosis and the presence of cornoid lamellae point more strongly towards Grover's disease.
